title: Proofreading & Academic Editing
tagline: Transform rough thesis drafts into publication-ready academic manuscripts.
outcomes: Execute the Three-Pass editing framework across argument structure, paragraphs, and sentences.
Eliminate nominalizations, wordiness, and bureaucratic academic fluff to achieve crisp prose.
Resolve common ESL grammatical errors including article omissions and subject-verb disagreements.
Format APA 7 tables, figures, and front matter to professional publication standards.

modules.title: Module 1: The Three-Pass Editing Architecture
modules.description: Separate global structural evaluation from granular sentence-level polishing.

lessons.title: The Structural, Paragraph, and Sentence Passes
Pass 1: Argument Flow, Section Headings & Transitions
Pass 2: Topic Sentences and Paragraph Cohesion

modules.title: Module 2: Sentence-Level Clarity & Concision
modules.description: Techniques for pruning redundant words and strengthening academic verbs.

lessons.title: Active vs Passive Voice in Empirical Papers
Eliminating Dangling Modifiers and Ambiguous Pronouns

modules.title: Module 3: Grammar Traps for Second-Language Writers
modules.description: Direct solutions for English as a second language grammar and syntax hurdles.

modules.title: Module 4: Tables, Figures & Final Submission
modules.description: Format tables, inspect typography, and execute pre-binding verification.
